title:
Know every
plant you *grow*
body: Point your camera at any plant and get an answer in seconds.
shot: Result screen: Bigleaf Hydrangea, 95% confident, with the toxicity banner showing.

title:
Honest about
how *sure* it is
body: Every answer shows its confidence, and the other possibilities when it's close.
shot: Result screen scrolled to Other possibilities, with the percentages listed.

title:
Care that follows
the *seasons*
body: Light, water, warmth and humidity — and what to do this time of year.
shot: Care section: the seasonal watering card above the four care tiles.

title:
Know what's
*safe* for pets
body: Clear warnings for cats, dogs and children, with the sources named.
shot: The toxicity card for hydrangea, with severity per species and what to do.

title:
Fix problems
*before* they spread
body: What's going wrong, why it happens, and exactly what to do.
shot: The 'If something looks wrong' section with three problems and their fixes.

title:
Every plant,
its own *journal*
body: A watering log, a photo journal and a health check for each one you save.
shot: A saved plant's page: the Water, Journal and Health tiles under its photo.

title:
Look up *any*
plant
body: Care notes for 136 plants. No scan needed.
shot: The plant lookup list, showing the library and its search field.

title:
Reminders from
your *own* log
body: Not a generic schedule — Sorrel goes by how you actually water.
shot: Settings: toxicity warnings and watering reminders, with the units and hemisphere controls.

title:
Beautiful in
light or *dark*
body: Follows your iPhone, or pick the look you prefer.
shot: Settings: the Automatic / Light / Dark appearance picker.

title:
No traps
*Cancel* any time
body: See the price before any trial starts. No account needed.
shot: Onboarding: the 'Built on three promises' screen.
